news.title: Dine and dasher assaults bartender at popular midtown restaurant, police say
news.summary: Officers said they were called to the restaurant on West Peachtree Street around 10 p.m. A bartender told police that he confronted a customer who left without paying their bill.

news.title: Metro Atlanta cop didn’t misuse Flock cameras checking up on significant other’s ex, DA finds
news.summary: A metro Atlanta police sergeant is back on the force after investigators determined he did not misuse Flock cameras.

news.title: Family of teen killed by Newnan police to make announcement
news.summary: Civil rights attorneys and relatives of Zadarious Dorsey plan to announce a major legal update Friday following the fatal shooting of the 18-year-old by a Newnan police officer.

news.title: Grieving family says 14, 17-year-old brothers gunned down in vape sale were robbed of life ahead
news.summary: Mother recalls moment she learned her teen sons were shot. Gwinnett County Police arrest 19-year-old in connection with their deaths.

news.title: Woman raped by three men during Halloween event at downtown Athens country bar, police report says
news.summary: The woman told police she encountered a man dressed as the Joker who offered to buy her a drink. After she declined, the man allegedly grabbed her by the arm.

news.title: Suwanee missing person: Gwinnett police search for Robert Grissom, 81
news.summary: Gwinnett County police are asking for the public's help finding Robert Grissom, 81, who was reported missing in Suwanee.

news.title: Cross Keys High School threat: Student investigated after social media post
news.summary: Cross Keys High School administrators and district police responded quickly to a student social media threat in Atlanta.

news.title: Atlanta shooting: 2 women hurt at apartments off Campbellton Road
news.summary: Two females are recovering after gunfire erupted Thursday afternoon at a southwest Atlanta location.
